title: Publisher: fold exports into a portfolio
spec: Add src/archive/publish.ts: buildPortfolio({ did, exports: { room, jsonl }[] }) → Portfolio. For every contract the DID took part in: parseTranscriptExport, foldTranscript, and record the folded status, counterparty, amount, asset, rail and the export digests. Contracts whose fold rejects the handshake are listed under `unfolded` with the reason, never silently dropped.
